# WA Folders

> WA Folders is a Chrome extension for WhatsApp Web (web.whatsapp.com) that adds chat folders as tabs above the chat list, search across chat names, private notes and opened messages, chat export (HTML, CSV, Markdown, JSON), and "waiting on you" follow-up reminders. Data stays in Chrome on the user's computer: no account, no WA Folders server, no analytics, and it never sends messages. Independent; not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.

Pricing: free plan with no time limit (5 folders, 20 search results per search, 3 exports a day, 5 voice-note transcriptions and 20 translations a day, 2 reminders at a time, 3 quick replies, 1 auto-file rule). Pro is a one-time $4.99 payment, no subscription, and removes those limits. There is no free trial of Pro.

Interface languages: English, Español, Português (Brasil), हिन्दी, Bahasa Indonesia, العربية.

Works only in desktop Chrome on web.whatsapp.com, not in the WhatsApp phone or desktop apps. Current version: 1.3.10. Not the same product as "WA Folders Pro", which is a different developer's extension.

## Common questions
- Does WhatsApp Web have folders? Not as folders. WhatsApp has Lists (All, Unread, Favorites, Groups and custom lists) whose setup steps are written for the phone apps. WA Folders adds folder tabs above the chat list on web.whatsapp.com.
- Is WA Folders free? Yes, the free plan has no time limit. Pro is US$4.99 once, no subscription, no free trial.
- Does it send messages or use a server? It never sends messages. Data stays in Chrome's local storage; there is no account, analytics, ads or WA Folders server.
- Does it work on the phone app or WhatsApp Desktop? No, only web.whatsapp.com in desktop Chrome.
- Can WA Folders search by date? No. Use WhatsApp's own calendar search inside a chat; WA Folders searches chat names, private notes and messages from chats you opened.
- Who makes it? Toolshed, an independent developer. Not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.
